subject: Clarify invoice routing and channel margin for AWS private offer
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@reachcloud.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@reachcloud.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: AWS private offer — invoice routing & channel split

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to loop you in — we need to confirm two things before we can sign the private offer:

1) Invoice routing: ReachCloud needs invoices to flow to our AP mailbox (procurement@reachcloud.com) with line-level SKU detail and a PO number. Can Redwood send the invoice directly to that address or do we need a partner intermediary?

2) Channel margin split: our finance team requires a one-line summary that shows net revenue allocation to ReachCloud (reseller margin) vs Redwood net for the private-offer SKU. We do not need transaction-level reporting at signing, but we need the margin waterfall and where credits/escrows land.

I attached our PO template and a simple workbook with the fields finance expects. Can you confirm by Thursday?

Thanks,
Alicia

Attachments: reachcloud_po_draft.pdf (pdf), channel_margin_workbook.xlsx (xlsx)

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@reachcloud.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — invoice routing & channel split

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and the files. Looping Ben (sales) and Jordan (partner ops) so we can surface the accounting path and the reseller margin flow. A few quick answers up front:

- Invoice routing: Redwood can send invoices directly to procurement@reachcloud.com and include the PO number and SKU-line detail. For the private offer we typically set the billing entity to Redwood Inc.; if ReachCloud needs invoices to show a partner-commission line we can add an invoice memo field.

- Channel margin split: we can provide a waterfall summary (list price → discounts → partner commission → net Redwood revenue). The partner commission typically flows as a contra-revenue credit on Redwood books and then as a payment to the partner. I want to confirm the preferred cadence for the payment (monthly vs quarterly) and whether ReachCloud expects the commission to be reflected on the invoice or handled off-invoice via partner settlement.

Jordan — can you confirm the technical invoice payload options (line-level JSON vs PDF only) and whether adding a partner-commission line on the invoice creates any downstream reconciliation issues?

Ben — can you provide the proposed commission % so we can model the waterfall?

I’ll also attach a short note on our typical private-offer invoicing flow.

Best,
Laura

Attachment: aws_private_offer_flow.docx

From: jordan.blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@reachcloud.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — invoice routing & channel split

Hi — quick technical notes from ops:

- Invoice payloads: we can provide either PDF invoices delivered to the AP email or a structured line-level JSON (SFTP/secure API) with SKU, quantity, unit price, discount lines, and PO number. For Hub integrations we can also push to an SFTP location that your ERP picks up.

- Partner commission on-invoice: adding an explicit "Partner commission" line is technically supported, but it will be treated as a negative line item on our invoice template (contra-revenue). This increases reconciliation complexity for us (we have to produce offsetting settlement records). If ReachCloud prefers simpler AR posting, the common approach is to keep the invoice showing Redwood net and handle partner payouts off-invoice via monthly settlement run.

- Escrow/credits: if you need any upfront credits or early-adopter incentives that are escrowed, we can surface that as a separate credit memo that references the PO.

Would you prefer a PDF-only integration for now and we can add the JSON feed after go-live?

Jordan
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@reachcloud.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — invoice routing & channel split

Alicia — good to meet you earlier. For modeling purposes ReachCloud proposed 12% reseller commission on list price for the private-offer SKU. If that works I can produce a waterfall example showing:

1) List price (AWS private-offer SKU)
2) Private-offer discount applied by Redwood (the negotiated discount)
3) Partner commission = 12% of list price (paid monthly as a settlement)
4) Net Redwood recognized revenue after commissions and credits

Two caveats:
- If ReachCloud needs the commission visible on the invoice we’ll need a short statement of work for accounting to handle settlement rows. That typically adds 1–2 weeks to the invoicing setup.
- If you plan to route invoices through the partner (ReachCloud) instead of Redwood, we have to restructure the private offer to list the billing entity as ReachCloud; that requires legal/contract changes and Amazon Marketplace alignment.

If you’re okay with commission paid off-invoice monthly, I’ll share a sample waterfall spreadsheet populated with the numbers and a mock invoice.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@reachcloud.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@reachcloud.com, Markus Brandt <mbrandt@reachcloud.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — invoice routing & channel split

Laura/Ben/Jordan — thanks all. ReachCloud prefers:

- invoices delivered directly to procurement@reachcloud.com (PDF is fine for now; structured feed would be nice post-launch)
- commission paid monthly via partner settlement (off-invoice) — this keeps our AP clean.
- we still need the one-line waterfall summary in the offer paperwork that shows how the list price maps to ReachCloud net (commission) and Redwood net.

Markus attached a signed PO and the procurement team uploaded the channel-workbook to the Drive folder (link above). Can you send the waterfall mock and the brief accounting note that Jordan mentioned by EOD Wednesday so our finance team can close the remaining open items?

Thanks,
Alicia

Attachments: reachcloud_signed_po.pdf (pdf)
